concepts.def: After H runs out; lower mass star

walkthroughs.body_html:
Our system: Sun, 8 planets, dwarf planets, moons, asteroids and comets.

The Sun is in the Milky Way galaxy.

Orbits are kept by gravity providing centripetal force.

Closer orbits = faster speed.

Nebula -> protostar -> main sequence.

Lower mass: red giant -> white dwarf.

Higher mass: red supergiant -> supernova -> neutron star or black hole.
